Confirmed: I commit to **zero tons this month**, **six tons next month** under our 30-ton combined recovery cap, and ten tons per month once the lake returns to 100, provided we all maintain that limit.

Everyone has now agreed, so our upcoming choices are **John 15, Kate 15, Jack 15, Emma 15, Luke 0**, with your four $15,000 donations paid directly to the clinic today. This harvest leaves 40 tons to reproduce into 80; next month’s 30-ton cap leaves 50 to restore the stock to 100.

Let’s follow through on those choices, then review the revealed catches and share donation receipts here. Thank you all for accepting this one-month sacrifice for our neighbors.
